name: etihad_2026_launches
title: Etihad's 2026 route launches into our markets (as flown or scheduled, 3 Oct 2026)
notes: Only routes into the 45 hotel-data nationalities. Excluded: Almaty (postponed to 2027, Etihad SVP via Times of Central Asia 11 Aug 2026), Tbilisi (cancelled, AeroRoutes 28 May 2026), Baku and Yerevan (conflicting reports: cancelled per AeroRoutes 14 Mar 2026, listed as launched by The National 11 Sep 2026), and destinations without a hotel series (Damascus, Kabul, Zanzibar, Asmara, Luxembourg).

Seats per flight come from the aircraft class (aircraft_seats.csv: median Etihad seats per flight in the data, narrowbody vs widebody); where the source names no aircraft the class is assumed and flagged.
